idle.title: Ready to Start
idle.description: Connect your device to begin the walkthrough.
idle.instructions: Click Start to begin the configuration process.

step1-horizontal.title: Horizontal Movement (Contact)
step1-horizontal.description: This will help us identify which bytes represent the X coordinate.
step1-horizontal.instructions: Draw a horizontal line from left to right while pressing down on the tablet.

step2-vertical.title: Vertical Movement (Contact)
step2-vertical.description: This will help us identify which bytes represent the Y coordinate.
step2-vertical.instructions: Draw a vertical line from top to bottom while pressing down on the tablet.

step3-pressure.title: Pressure Detection
step3-pressure.description: This will help us identify which bytes represent pressure.
step3-pressure.instructions: Press down on the tablet and vary your pressure from light to heavy.

step4-hover-movement.title: Hover Movement
step4-hover-movement.description: This helps identify X and Y coordinate bytes without pressure interference.
step4-hover-movement.instructions: Hover your pen above the tablet and move it around freely (both horizontally and vertically).

step5-tilt-x.title: Tilt X Detection
step5-tilt-x.description: This will help us identify which byte represents X tilt.
step5-tilt-x.instructions: Tilt your pen left and right while keeping it in contact with the tablet.

step6-tilt-y.title: Tilt Y Detection
step6-tilt-y.description: This will help us identify which byte represents Y tilt.
step6-tilt-y.instructions: Tilt your pen forward and backward while keeping it in contact with the tablet.

step7-primary-button.title: Primary Button Detection
step7-primary-button.description: This will help us identify the status byte value for primary button.
step7-primary-button.instructions: Press and hold the primary button on your pen while moving across the tablet.

step8-secondary-button.title: Secondary Button Detection
step8-secondary-button.description: This will help us identify the status byte value for secondary button.
step8-secondary-button.instructions: Press and hold the secondary button on your pen while moving across the tablet.

step9-tablet-buttons.title: Tablet Buttons Detection
step9-tablet-buttons.description: We'll detect how many buttons your tablet has and their byte values.
step9-tablet-buttons.instructions: Press different buttons on your tablet (not the pen buttons).

step10-metadata.title: Device Information
step10-metadata.description: Please provide additional information about your device to complete the configuration.
step10-metadata.instructions: Fill in the device name, manufacturer, model, and description.

complete.title: Configuration Complete
complete.description: Your device configuration has been generated.
complete.instructions: You can now save or use the generated configuration.
